names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 20 mai, «Sfântul Mucenic Talaleu».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 20 Μαΐου, «Άγιος Θαλλέλαιος ο Ανάργυρος», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 20. мај ст. ст., „Свети мученик Талалеј.“ — Свети is not a rank and мученик is the `martyr` this corpus puts in `types`; strip them and the bare forename is left, which is all the heading gives. The body repeats it bare three times. Measured before drafting with `foldchk.py`: `[('thalelaeus-of-gabala', 'sr')]`, so the fold is two wide and is read in this batch’s commit message.

The heading of the calendar’s name link 2159, «Фалалей Эгейский, мч.», with the rank abbreviation left off; the day’s own line gives the name alone, in the genitive, without the city. `fk.mjs` returned NONE for the form before the write.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 20 мая ст. ст. — «Мчч. Фалалея , Александра и Астерия (284).»

attestations.note: The identification is exact and not a name match. The calendar’s life page, life1108, heads him «Мученик Фалалей Эгейский» and makes him the eighteen-year-old of Lebanon brought before the governor of Aegae under Numerian, whom it dates 283 to 284; he says of himself «Я же обучен врачебному делу врачом Макарием», that he was taught the physician’s craft by the physician Макарий, which is the trade this folder’s own display name carries, and the calendar closes by saying the Church calls him Бессребреник, unmercenary, because he healed without payment. The same day, the same city, the same year and the same two companions as the Romanian, Greek and Serbian rows already on this folder. `dates` is unchanged: the folder holds 284 off the Охридски пролог and both the Russian day line and the Russian life give the same year, «Это произошло в 284 году». The life page lists no day but this one. What the Russian adds and the paragraph now carries: his father Берукий the commander and his mother Ромилия, the brother in subdeacon’s orders, the earlier arrest in Lebanon before the governor Тиверий, the drilled log hung in his place, the magician Урвикиан torn by the beasts the crowd threw him to, and his relics in the church of St Agathonicus at Constantinople. azbyka.ru was not read.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 20ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Θαλλέλαιος ο Ανάργυρος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 20 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same civil day the Romanian calendar keeps «Sfântul Mucenic Talaleu» on, and both sources give him the same epithet, the Unmercenary physician. The Greek adds a great deal: Lebanon for a country, parents «Βερούκιος» and «Ρωμυλία» (κατ' άλλους Βερεκκόκιος and Ρομβυλιανή), the reign of Numerian 283–284, the arrest at Anazarbus in the second province of Cilicia, the governor Tiberian, and the beheading «στην Έδεσσα των Αιγαίων, το φθινόπωρο του 284 μ.Χ. (κατά άλλους τον Μάιο του 289 μ.Χ.)». **The folder's `dates` is left empty on purpose**: the page offers two years five apart and will not choose between them, and a year the source itself doubts is not a recorded one. The page also says that his synaxis was kept at his martyrium inside the church of Saint Agathonikos, that there was a church of his near the mountain of Auxentius, that Justinian «ἀνανεώσατο» a monastery of his name in Palestine on Procopius's testimony, and that **some monasteries kept his memory on 3 Σεπτεμβρίου and others on 23 Αυγούστου**, the day he was brought to examination — two further days, recorded here as notes and not as rows, since one row per church is the schema. Relics: «Αποτμήματα… βρίσκονται στις Μονές Διονυσίου και Κωνσταμονίτου Αγίου Όρους». Four hymns are added, the second of them the common of a martyr printed as «Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον»; the page's three megalynaria, oikos and kathisma are not copied because the schema's `kind` enum holds only troparion and kontakion. The two soldiers his patience converted, Alexander and Asterius, are new folders in `el-05-20` — this folder's own life already names them in prose.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 02.06.2026 (20. мај ст. ст.) — „Свети мученик Талалеј.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, on the same menologion 20/5 the Romanian and Greek rows already carry, so nothing moved. **A FIRST DATE FOR A FOLDER THAT HELD NO `dates` OBJECT**: „пресели се у живот вечни 284. године“ → `death` 284. **No other book read for this folder gives a year**, and 284 agrees with the reign the entry names, „у време царовања Нумеријанова“ — **and that reign was itself given no bounds and nothing was built on it**, as this wave has refused four such reigns in five days. **New here, and almost the whole of it**: that he was **of Lebanon**; that his father was **Верукије** and his mother **Ромилија**; that he was **eighteen years old**, comely in face and in body, and **„косе црвеножуте“**, red-yellow haired; that he was **„Лекар по занимању“**, a physician by trade, which is the `physician` this folder carries read from the other side; the **drill through the knees**, the rope through the drilled bones and the hanging from a tree; **that the two executioners were struck as if blind and bored a plank instead of him**; **that the torturer took the drill himself and his hands seized up, so that he had to beg Thalaleus to save him, and that the guileless martyr did it by prayer**; that he was thrown into water and **came alive before the torturer again, because he had asked God not to die at once but that his tortures be lengthened**; that **the beasts licked his feet and fawned on him**; and that he was beheaded at the last. **His parents’ names and his age take no folder and no row** — no calendar read for this corpus keeps either parent, and by the coordinator’s third ruling nothing is minted for them. **The age is not a date**: eighteen years at a death in 284 is a birth of 266, and nothing is derived from it, as nothing was derived from Pachomius’s seventy-four years or Christina’s sixteen. **`related` ROWS ADDED, FILLING A COMPANY THAT RELATED NOBODY.** `thalaleus-the-physician`, `alexander-companion-of-thalaleus` and `asterius-companion-of-thalaleus` all carried **`related: None`** — three folders of one martyrdom, two of them named after Thalaleus in their own display names, relating nobody at all, exactly as Patrick of Prusa’s four did on the Julian 19 May. This entry narrates the three in one scene, so **each now relates the other two**. `types` untouched — мученик is the `martyr` and Лекар the `physician`, both held. No `locations`, although Lebanon is named. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Mucenicul Tău, Doamne, Talaleu, întru nevoinţa sa, cununa nesctricăciunii a dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru; că având puterea Ta, pe chinuitori a învins; zdrobit-a şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lui, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

english.text: Your martyr Thalaleus, O Lord, in his contest received from You, our God, the crown of incorruption; for having Your power he overthrew his tormentors and broke the powerless insolence of the demons. At his prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.

hymns.text: Μαρτυρίου ἀνύσας τὸν ἀγῶνα Θαλλέλαιε, ἤσχυνας εἰδώλων τὴν πλάνην, τὴ γενναία ἀθλήσει σου· καὶ ὤφθης ἰαμάτων θησαυρός, παρέχων τᾶς ἰάσεις δωρεάν, τοὶς προστρέχουσιν ἐν πίστει τῷ σῷ ναῶ καὶ πόθω ἄνακραζουσι · δόξα τῷ δεδωκότι σοι ἰσχύν, δόξα τῷ σὲ θαυμαστώσαντι, δόξα τῷ ἐνεργούντι διὰ σοῦ, πάσιν ἰάματα.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος α’, Τῆς ἐρήμου πολίτης, on the page of «Άγιος Θαλλέλαιος ο Ανάργυρος»

english.text: Having finished the contest of martyrdom, Thalaleus, you put the error of the idols to shame by your brave contending; and you were shown a treasury of healings, granting cures freely to those who run in faith to your church and cry out with longing: glory to him who gave you strength, glory to him who made you wonderful, glory to him who works healings for all through you.

hymns.text: Ὁ Μάρτυς σου Κύριε, ἐν τῇ ἀθλήσει αὐτοῦ, τὸ στέφος ἐκομίσατο τῆς ἀφθαρσίας, ἐκ σοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν· ἔχων γὰρ τὴν ἰσχύν σου, τοὺς τυράννους καθεῖλεν ἔθραυσε καὶ δαιμόνων τὰ ἀνίσχυρα θράση. Αὐτοῦ ταῖς ἱκεσίαις Χριστὲ ὁ Θεός, σῶσον τὰς ψυχὰς ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ’, on the page of «Άγιος Θαλλέλαιος ο Ανάργυρος» — the common of a martyr

english.text: Your martyr, O Lord, in his contest received the crown of incorruption from you, our God; for having your strength he brought the tyrants down and shattered the powerless insolence of the demons. At his entreaties, Christ God, save our souls.

hymns.text: Ἀθλοφόρε Ἅγιε καὶ ἰαματικὲ Θαλλέλαιε, πρέσβευε τῷ ἐλεήμονι Θεῷ, ἵνα πταισμάτων ἄφεσιν παράσχῃ ταῖς ψυχαῖς ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος γ’, on the page of «Άγιος Θαλλέλαιος ο Ανάργυρος»

english.text: Holy prize-winner and healer Thalaleus, intercede with the merciful God that he may grant our souls forgiveness of our offences.

hymns.text: Τῶν Μαρτύρων σύναθλος, ἀναδειχθεὶς καὶ ὁπλίτης, στρατιώτης ἄριστος, τοῦ Βασιλέως τῆς δόξης, γέγονας διὰ βασάνων καὶ τιμωρίας, ἔπαρσιν εἰδωλολατρῶν καταπατήσας, διὰ τοῦτο τὴν σεπτήν σου, ὑμνοῦμεν μνήμην σοφὲ Θαλλέλαιε.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος γ’, Ἡ Παρθένος σήμερον, on the page of «Άγιος Θαλλέλαιος ο Ανάργυρος»

english.text: Shown a fellow-contender of the martyrs and a man-at-arms, you became through tortures and punishments an excellent soldier of the King of glory, and trod down the arrogance of the idolaters; and therefore we sing your honoured memory, O wise Thalaleus.

hymns.text: Мучеником сострадалец явлься и оружник,/ воин изрядный Царя славы был еси,/ искушеньми и мукою возвышение идолослужителеи попрал еси,/ сего ради честную твою поем память,/ мудре Фалалее.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 20 мая ст. ст., «Кондак мученика Фалалея», глас 3 — proper to him, and it names him and nobody else; it is the only hymn the day page prints under any of the three martyrs’ names

english.text: Shown forth as a fellow-sufferer with the martyrs and as their comrade in arms, thou wast an excellent soldier of the King of glory; by trials and by torment thou didst trample down the arrogance of the idolaters. Therefore do we hymn thy honoured memory, O wise Thalaleus.

death.note: The Охридски пролог for 20. мај ст. ст.: „Најзад би посечен мачем и пресели се у живот вечни 284. године.“ This folder held no `dates` object at all until now, and neither doxologia nor saint.gr gave it a year. The reign the entry names, „у време царовања Нумеријанова“, is given no bounds on the page and nothing is built on it; the eighteen years the entry gives his age are a duration and no year of birth is reckoned from them. The year is given of Thalaleus, in the sentence about his own beheading, and is deliberately not carried to the two executioners who died earlier in the same scene.
